description: Finite reviewed official non-executable robot model, description and controller/configuration text artifacts. Source-only references; no runtime or complete-coverage claim.
refresh_policy: Review exact commit, source bytes and applicable license before changing these explicit pins. --fetch verifies existing pins only. Xacro/includes/models/configuration are never evaluated by the importer.
